title: Banner Rush
description: Drag marching columns between round castles, outgrow two rival banners and capture every keep across three maps of rising difficulty.
controls: Drag from one of your blue castles to any other castle to send half its troops. Sweep across several of your castles to send from all of them. Tap a castle, then a target, as an alternative.

zh-CN.title: 旗争：城堡争夺战
zh-CN.description: 从自家城堡拖向任意城堡派出半数兵力，压过赤、金两路对手，在三张由易到难的地图上占领每一座城堡。
zh-CN.controls: 从蓝色城堡拖到另一座城堡，派出一半兵力；拖动时划过多座蓝色城堡可一起出兵；也可先点己方城堡再点目标。
